acceptance_note: 1% is a proposed feature residual target, not a claim of survey accuracy. Camera controls and withheld check landmarks are reported separately. Out-of-target and unobserved features remain explicit exceptions; no geometry is altered to improve a score. The target flag requires both whole projected width and observed span; the latter prevents false passes from off-frame or unstable width extrapolations. Mesh association >0.30 m is unresolved.

phase_rules.note: Unbuilt preliminary schemes and Houghton design sketches are not 1904 facts.
Taylor 2135 brackets street form; HABS later dimensions carry back feature by feature only with alteration exclusions.
1946 overhead stable door, loft infill and courtyard paving; later signs, air conditioners, utility objects and stairs cannot set 1904 appearance.
Modern restored finishes, planting and replacement fittings do not date their historical state.
T-2235 west roof topology is the owner-directed working reconstruction. A photograph fit is not permission to erase or silently promote it.
